GracePrinciples.Principle: Contract-first changes: clarify scope and verification before implementation.
Keep semantic anchors stable and grep-friendly.
Use assertions, scopes, and tests as fresh completion evidence.

Layers stay separate: services own one external source each, repositories compose sources and own domain merging, widgets render only, and every provider is registered in lib/dependency_injection/app_scope.dart.
UI follows the documented style: docs/CODE_STYLE.md and the gt7-* skills are the reference for screen skeleton, spacing scale, card shell, states and colour rules.
Two widget generations coexist; edit a legacy file in its own style and write new code in the canon, rather than restyling unrelated files.
Telemetry is the one subsystem whose tokens live in lib/theme/gt7_theme.dart; other UI reads Theme.of(context) and must not pull those helpers in.
